summary.intent: Finish and verify fixes for PR #531 (no-pending-changesets warning), confirm it is mergeable, and then bring the README, docs and ARCHITECTURE.md up to date with the many changes made in this session.
summary.outcome: Fixed the review finding on #531 with a test-first guard change, pushed it with all commits showing verified, confirmed #531 is MERGEABLE and updated its description. A docs audit was delegated to an agent to fix drift and add a verified 'What you get' README section; only docs/architecture/versioning.md had been modified so far.

repo: Prerelease reruns can have a recorded changeset override an inferred bump; the 'already recorded in pre.json' cleanup then removes the bump but leaves agg.inference_commits populated, so the guard must check named_by == Inference rather than whether inference records exist.

`just test` gives 2,585 passed and 1 failed; the failure is a_version_the_registry_serves_is_exact_with_no_checksum_or_yank_claim, a `cargo info` output test that fails identically on main (environment-specific, CI is the authority).
Pre-merge checks are driven by just recipes: pre-push, lint, doc-check, workflow-contracts.
PR bodies carry an `entire-shadow-pr` marker that must be preserved when editing so Entire can still close the PR with its trail; BLOCKED merge status is the Entire approval gate, not a conflict.

ARCHITECTURE.md invariant 7 (stable error codes) lacks two enforced invariants: exit classification via exit_kind() (flag-value errors exit 2, everything else exit 1) and typed JSON reports via emit_report with untyped JSON output crate-private (#505).
docs/specs/versioning.json VER-APPLY-10 describes --emit-decision as relative to the workspace root but after #528 the path must also be inside the workspace (E225/E226, exit 2).
wire-compat.md's hard-coded schemaVersion: 2 for release-pr snapshots is a different schema from the one that moved to 3, so it is correct.

README is thin: it only says 'Cargo, npm/pnpm, and PyPI monorepos' and 'tags, GitHub releases, and assets'. npm provenance is documented only in docs/publishing.md and release-artifact attestations appear in no user-facing doc.

friction: The initial docs check was too narrow and wrongly concluded docs were mostly current, until the user pushed back.
The sed replacement on the PR body file was followed by a separate Edit, suggesting the first attempt may not have applied cleanly.
One test fails locally on every run because of the environment, adding noise to test results.
open_items: Merge #530 and #531 once CI passes (user action).
Review the docs agent's audit and the proposed README 'What you get' section (max 14 lines), especially the wording of attestation claims, before any PR opens.
Add the ARCHITECTURE.md invariants for exit classification and typed JSON envelope, and fix the VER-APPLY-10 wording in versioning.json; link to trail #357 first.
Choose the next work: the OIDC or E194 decision brief, or the Caliper session.
